conflicts.permit: These tools place persistent cookies in your browser to identify you as a unique user the next time you visit our website.
conflicts.prohibit: We do not use cookies for tracking purposes.
conflicts.situation: Using persistent cookies to identify and track a returning user across visits to the website.
conflicts.reason: The policy states it places cookies to uniquely identify users across visits while simultaneously claiming cookies are not used for tracking purposes, without reconciling the two statements.
